reasons.single-k-reported-error: All Form 1040 amounts the rule lists are zero; MeF rejects an all-zero return.
reasons.single-two-at-risk-business-losses: Schedule 1 line 3 correctly takes the Form 6198 allowable losses (1,600). S1-F1040-195 requires it to equal the sum of Schedule C NetProfitOrLossAmt (-2,000), while SC-F1040-023-01 requires each NetProfitOrLossAmt to equal line 29 minus line 30, so no line 31 value satisfies both when the at-risk limit binds. How MeF expects the limit (the otherLossAmt attribute is one candidate) is unverified.
reasons.single-form2555-full-year-physical-prese: The full Form 2555 exclusion leaves every amount F1040-065-05 lists at zero; MeF rejects an all-zero return.
